title: Tralty's Modded Adventure 2
description: Tralty's Modded Adventure 2 | NeoForge | 1.21.1 | Made for exploring what is new without any limitations!
body:
![Header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tralty/traltys-modded-adventure-2/refs/heads/main/TMA2_Header.webp)

![Description](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tralty/traltys-modded-adventure-2/refs/heads/main/TMA2-Description.webp) Welcome to Tralty's Modded Adventure 2! This sequel has Serene Seasons, so most plants cannot be grown unless you grow them using Botany Pots or Immersive Engineering using a Botany Pot or Garden Cloche (you can grow Mystical Agriculture plants in the Cloche) so you can ensure you have enough resources without having to worry about the seasons. With Regions Unexplored and Oh The Biomes We've Gone, the terrain of your worlds will be looking amazing and more realistic as the prequel lacked this. Additionally, you'll be able explore your returning favorites that has new features and new ones that can one day become a returning favorite!

![Special Thanks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tralty/traltys-modded-adventure-2/refs/heads/main/TMA2-ST.webp) I want to give credit to [**CesarZorak**](https://modrinth.com/user/CesarZorak) for allowing the use of [**Mandala's GUI - Dark mode**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mandalas-gui-dark-mode) and [**Mandala's GUI - Add-Ons**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mandalas-gui-add-ons)! Also, [**zozozrob**](https://modrinth.com/user/zozozrob) for [**Fresh Waystones Texture**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-waystones-texture)!
